name: Should I hire a drywall finisher or a general contractor after plumbing repairs?
description: Hire a general contractor if you need framing backing, insulation, and paint matching handled together; hire a drywall finisher for simple patches.

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a drywall finisher or a general contractor after plumbing repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor handles the entire restoration from framing backing to final paint, whereas a dedicated drywall finisher usually focuses only on hanging, taping, and texturing. If the plumber cut through structural backing, damaged insulation, or left irregular cuts across multiple rooms, a licensed general contractor can manage framing support, insulation replacement, drywall finishing, and paint matching under one contract. For a clean, single-hole access cut where framing remains intact, a drywall finisher is often sufficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor if you need framing backing, insulation, and paint matching handled together; hire a drywall finisher for simple patches.
